FN-YAEY62-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 349
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 05/01/2023
House Bill 349 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama
Board of Optometry to become a certifying board pursuant to the Alabama Uniform Controlled
Substances Act and to certify optometrists to administer certain vaccines.
Page 1

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 349
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 05/16/2023
House Bill 349 as passed the House of Representatives would increase the administrative
obligations of the Alabama Board of Optometry to become a certifying board pursuant to the
Alabama Uniform Controlled Substances Act and to certify optometrists to administer certain
vaccines.
